name: narration-no-source-names
title: The narration never names the authors of the source books
why: prompts/script.md and prompts/rules_voice.md (rule 8: the viewer has never heard of the books) and docs/APP_GUIDE.md section 5.5: a line that names the author of a source book, or speaks of "the books" or "the sources", is the warning source_author_named or source_talk, and it stops an automatic run.
